name: Hare, wild boar & beaver
description: Other introduced herbivores - the European hare (Lepus europaeus), wild boar (Sus scrofa) and North American beaver (Castor canadensis). Functional group pooling 3 source nodes (0 native, 3 exotic, 0 mixed-origin); all three arrived with human settlement and graze and browse the steppe - the beaver is taken only by the mink.
